text: {"verdict": "supported", "answer": "The evidence directly supports the claim: a targeted siRNA screen and CRISPR/Cas9 knockout studies identify mammalian RAD52 as required for break-induced replication (BIR) repair, with Rad52 localizing to DNA replication stress foci and its loss compromising restart of collapsed forks. A separate study shows telomeric mitotic DNA synthesis (MiDAS), a RAD52-dependent process resembling BIR, requires RAD52. Both sources conclude that RAD52-dependent BIR helps cells, particularly cancer cells under replication stress, tolerate collapsed forks and telomeres.", "evidence_used": ["14332945", "4899981"]}
